between the fourth and fifth-placed teams of the regular season at the home stadium of the fourth-placed team, and its winners played the third-placed team in the second round. When the first and second round matches were finished as draws, their winners were decided on the regular season rankings without extra time and penalty shoot-outs. The winners of the second round, and the league runners-up competed with the tenth and eleventh-placed teams of the [[2024 K League 1]], respectively, in the final round.
